title: Chris Evans, Chris Pine & 4 Big Names Unite To Film New Crime Thriller
text:
Avengers' Chris Evans and Chris Pine lead a stacked cast of big-name stars in Elijah Bynum's upcoming crime thriller.
reportedly signing on in a major role. Evans steps in for Josh Brolin, who was previously attached but had to leave the project due to scheduling conflicts.
The casting update puts Evans alongside a group of big-name actors in what is rapidly becoming one of the more anticipated packages heading to the Cannes market.reported. Chris Pine, Jessica Chastain, Mikey Madison, Charles Melton, and Don Cheadle were already locked in for the movie. Bynum is directing the project after Magazine Dreams, the intense character study that got noticed on the festival circuit. The story is set in Los Angeles in 1980.
According to the official logline, the film “will chart how a single crime weaves together the lives of a TV host, his restless wife, a country music idol, two small-time crooks, and an ex-con, all of whom are chasing the promise of a better life. ” It is yet to be confirmed who plays which role. Nonetheless, Evans comes on the heels of a busy stretch that includes Celine Song’s Materialists and the massive Marvel Studios production Avengers: Doomsday.
His decision to join Bynum’s crime thriller continues a pattern of balancing large-scale franchise work with director-driven material. , who last featured in Rachel Lambert’s latest, called Carousel, brings his own experience in the neo-noir space to the project. Chastain, an Oscar winner for The Eyes of Tammy Faye, and Cheadle, recently seen in Prime Video’s Unstoppable, add further weight.
Madison, fresh off her Best Actress Oscar win for Sean Baker’s Anora, and Melton, who is currently receiving love for starring in With cameras expected to start rolling toward the end of summer, the race is on to finalize the remaining pieces.
